_metadata.description: P0 requirements: the authorization spine. Every entry here must hold before any automated rail is wired, because each one is a property that a later rail assumes rather than re-establishes.

requirements.description: The scenario shall admit every spend through exactly one typed grant naming authorizer, cap, counterparty scope and expiry, with each rail an adapter satisfying it and no privileged path
requirements.title: The mandate contract

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/mandate/service_test.go`. Constructing a mandate without an authorizer, cap, counterparty scope or expiry is rejected. [REQ:TRS-P0-001]

Planned test at `api/internal/rail/contract_test.go`. Every registered rail adapter satisfies the same execution interface; a table test enumerates registered rails so a new adapter cannot skip the contract. [REQ:TRS-P0-001]
Planned test at `api/internal/rail/registry_test.go`. No rail can settle a charge that carries no mandate reference, proving the absence of a privileged path. [REQ:TRS-P0-001]

requirements.description: When an agent submits a charge, the scenario shall evaluate it against its mandate inside the API, and the agent that read untrusted content shall never hold the decision
requirements.title: Policy evaluated server-side

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/policy/evaluator_test.go`. The evaluator derives its verdict only from stored mandate and budget state; caller-supplied verdict, allowance or override fields are ignored when present. [REQ:TRS-P0-002]

Planned test at `api/handlers/agentspend/authorize_test.go`. A charge request carrying an attacker-shaped payload that asserts its own approval is still evaluated from scratch and refused when out of scope. [REQ:TRS-P0-002]

requirements.description: A budget shall carry total, periodic and per-transaction caps plus counterparty allow and deny lists, and shall declare whether spends beneath it require human approval
requirements.title: Budgets carry caps, scope and gating

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/budget/service_test.go`. Each cap dimension refuses independently, and a deny-list entry outranks an allow-list entry for the same counterparty. [REQ:TRS-P0-003]
Planned test at `api/internal/budget/period_test.go`. Periodic caps roll over on their declared boundary and do not retroactively free headroom for charges already settled. [REQ:TRS-P0-003]

Planned automation at `bas/cases/budgets/configure.json`. An operator creates a budget with every cap dimension and both lists through the console, and the resulting authorization behaviour matches the configuration. [REQ:TRS-P0-003]

requirements.description: The agent-facing service shall expose no method that mutates policy, budgets or gating, so a caller holding a valid agent token cannot disable the gate that governs it
requirements.title: The approval gate is structurally out of agent reach

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/handlers/agentspend/surface_test.go`. Asserts against the generated proto service descriptor that AgentSpend declares no mutating policy, budget or gating method. This is a descriptor assertion rather than an authorization assertion by design: the guarantee is the absence of the RPC, not a permission check on it. [REQ:TRS-P0-004]
Planned test at `api/handlers/treasuryadmin/realm_test.go`. Every TreasuryAdmin method rejects an agent-realm token and accepts an operator-realm token. [REQ:TRS-P0-004]

requirements.description: If agent identity cannot be verified at authorization time, then the scenario shall refuse the spend rather than record it at a degraded evidence grade
requirements.title: Unverifiable callers cannot spend

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/identity/verify_test.go`. Transport failure, expired token, invalid signature and absent token each produce a refusal, and none produces a degraded-grade acceptance. [REQ:TRS-P0-005]

Planned test at `api/handlers/agentspend/authorize_failclosed_test.go`. With the identity authority unreachable, an authorization request is refused and the refusal is recorded as evidence with its cause. [REQ:TRS-P0-005]

requirements.description: The scenario shall own an approval queue and its operator surface, and shall relay requests through notification-hub only as an optional enhancement that approval never depends on
requirements.title: Approval is owned in-scenario and relayed when available

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/approval/service_test.go`. The queue admits, holds, resolves and expires requests with no relay configured. [REQ:TRS-P0-006]

Planned test at `api/internal/approval/relay_test.go`. With notification-hub unreachable, approval still admits and resolves; the relay failure is recorded without changing the approval outcome. [REQ:TRS-P0-006]

Planned automation at `bas/cases/approvals/approve-and-decline.json`. An operator approves one pending charge and declines another from the queue, and both outcomes reach the requesting caller. [REQ:TRS-P0-006]

requirements.description: The scenario shall accept an operator-settled payment as an ordinary rail adapter carrying the same mandate, evidence and emission path as any automated rail
requirements.title: The manual rail is first-class

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/rail/manual/adapter_test.go`. The manual adapter implements the same interface as every other rail and requires a mandate, a receipt reference and an operator attribution. [REQ:TRS-P0-007]

Planned test at `api/internal/rail/manual/parity_test.go`. A manual settlement produces the same evidence record shape and the same money event shape as an automated rail, differing only in basis. [REQ:TRS-P0-007]

requirements.description: When a charge settles, the scenario shall emit one idempotent money event to money-ledger through its existing inbound contract, carrying provenance and basis
requirements.title: Every settlement emits a money event

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/ledger/emitter_test.go`. The emitted payload satisfies money-ledger's money-event contract with adapter, external id, fetch time and a basis of authoritative or operator-asserted. [REQ:TRS-P0-008]
Planned test at `api/internal/ledger/emitter_replay_test.go`. Re-emitting a settled charge produces no duplicate posting downstream. [REQ:TRS-P0-008]

requirements.description: The scenario shall retain mandate, approval, request, rail response and receipt as one replayable record per spend attempt, including declines and expiries
requirements.title: Evidence is retained for every attempt

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/evidence/store_test.go`. Every terminal outcome writes a record, and the store refuses to mutate or delete an existing one. [REQ:TRS-P0-009]

Planned test at `api/internal/evidence/replay_test.go`. A stored record reconstructs the full decision path for an approved charge, a policy decline, an approval decline and an expiry. [REQ:TRS-P0-009]
Planned automation at `bas/cases/evidence/audit-trail.json`. An operator opens a declined attempt in the console and can see which constraint refused it. [REQ:TRS-P0-009]

requirements.description: The scenario shall refuse to custody value belonging to any party other than the operator, enforced at the contract boundary rather than by documented convention
requirements.title: Operator funds only

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/custody/boundary_test.go`. An instrument or balance whose beneficiary is not the operating account is rejected at construction. There is no configuration flag that relaxes this. [REQ:TRS-P0-010]

Planned test at `api/internal/custody/schema_test.go`. The persistence schema admits exactly one beneficiary identity, so a third-party balance has nowhere to be stored even if a future handler tried. [REQ:TRS-P0-010]

requirements.description: When a charge is retried under an unchanged idempotency key, the scenario shall return the first commit's outcome rather than moving money a second time
requirements.title: Idempotent settlement

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/settlement/idempotency_test.go`. A repeated key returns the original outcome; a distinct key under the same mandate is an independent charge. An absent key is refused rather than defaulted. [REQ:TRS-P0-011]
Planned test at `api/internal/settlement/concurrent_test.go`. Concurrent submissions of the same key resolve to exactly one settlement under row-level locking. [REQ:TRS-P0-011]

requirements.description: While a mandate is past its expiry, the scenario shall reject every charge presented against it, and expiry shall require no operator intervention to take effect
requirements.title: A mandate expires without action

validation.notes: Planned test at `api/internal/mandate/expiry_test.go`. Expiry is evaluated from the mandate's own timestamp at authorization time; no sweep, job or operator action is required for it to bind. [REQ:TRS-P0-012]
Planned test at `api/internal/mandate/expiry_clock_test.go`. A mandate that expires between authorization and settlement refuses the settlement. [REQ:TRS-P0-012]
